newsitem.title: FINLAND: Enso launches FIM 1.0 bln serial bond. [CORRECTED 09:02 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Enso launches FIM 1.0 bln serial bond. [CORRECTED 09:02 GMT]

text.p: Finnish forest industry group Enso Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it would launch a seven-year serial bond at variable issue price to institutional investors with a maximum amount of 1.0 billion markka. (Corrects type of bond).
The coupon would be fixed later, an official at lead manager Postipankki said. The bond matures on March 15, 2004.
"The bond will be issued in several tranches through an auction method," Enso said in its statement, adding that the bond would be listed on the Helsinki Stock Exchange.
